S.1.title: Appointment to fill the vacancy in Oregon Senate District 19 (joint meeting with the Clackamas and Washington County Boards of Commissioners).
S.1.synopsis: Meeting jointly with Clackamas and Washington counties' commissioners, the Board voted on filling the Oregon Senate District 19 vacancy by weighted roll call. Rob Wagner was appointed with a plurality. Here Yea means a vote for Wagner: Commissioners Meieran and Smith voted for Wagner; Commissioners Stegmann and Vega Pederson and Chair Kafoury voted for Claudia Black.
